cases.name: write-pr-description
cases.input: Write the PR description for this branch.
cases.why: The plainest phrasing of the task the skill exists for.

cases.name: what-should-it-say
cases.input: I'm opening a PR for the retry-lock fix. What should it say?
cases.why: Names no artifact and no command — fires on intent alone.

cases.name: empty-body
cases.input: I opened the PR but left the body empty. Can you fill it in?
cases.why: The symptom, not the deliberate action. Someone who knew the skill existed would not phrase it this way.

cases.name: gh-pr-create
cases.input: Draft the title and summary for gh pr create.
cases.why: The command in the description, with no other cue.

cases.name: commit-message
cases.input: Write a commit message for these staged changes.
cases.why: The discriminating case. The skill says the PR title IS the commit subject, so it has every reason to over-fire here. It should not: nothing is being opened.

cases.name: review-diff
cases.input: Review this diff for bugs before I push it.
cases.why: Reviewing, not authoring. Belongs to a review skill.

cases.name: split-branch
cases.input: This branch touches 40 files across three unrelated concerns. Should I split it up?
cases.why: Splitting, which the skill's Precedence section hands to gh-stack.

cases.name: rebase-howto
cases.input: How do I rebase this branch onto main without losing my signatures?
cases.why: Git mechanics near a PR but not about one. Guards against firing on branch vocabulary alone.
